scope: process environment, then server2/.env in the working directory (legacy dotenv rules); setting names only, no credential values
native_routing: SERVER2_NATIVE_FAMILIES: comma list of geocode, dsf and kma; unset keeps every family on legacy
geocoder_builtins: 100000 units per Kakao key and UTC day
322 units for the Google key per UTC day
s3_settings: TWA_S3_REGION (default ap-northeast-2; endpoint https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com/ built in)
weather_family_routing: legacy HTTP unless the family is listed; SERVER2_WORLD_VERSIONS selects dsf versions
coordinate_cache: bounded volatile exact normalized coordinate+locale; no S3
address_cache: optional bounded address-only S3 projection; 30-day freshness; not wired by the process
activation: measured quota limits (#2724), label/shadow and cutover prerequisites before production routing
